description: Accepted two-packet results reused from the isolated depth sweep. Repository package uses fixed default FIFO_DEPTH=2 in feed_lane; assembly/packet size and SRAM capacities are unchanged. Depth sweep exposed the parameter through the hierarchy and explicitly wrapped pointers; at depth two this is equivalent to the packaged one-bit pointer truncation. Integration checks for this package are recorded separately.
limitations: Cycle-equivalent to depth eight on the 39 workloads, not universally. A legal extreme padding=192/stride=8 case takes112 cycles at depth2 versus111 at depth8. Simulation does not establish timing closure or measured power.

package_integration.elaboration: All ten feed_lane instances have FIFO_DEPTH=2
